title: stylogyne chartacea
intro: Stylogyne chartacea, commonly known as the "Red-stemmed Stylogyne" or "Wild coffee," is a species of flowering plant in the family Primulaceae. It is native to the tropical regions of Central and South America, particularly in the countries of Costa Rica, Nicaragua, and Panama. Stylogyne chartacea is valued for its medicinal properties, offering potential health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, which may aid in reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and boosting immune function. The plant's bioactive constituents include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
